'''Matcha Flavoured 1.03''', "Steel, Electrum, and Trial Chambers", is a release of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on July 27, 2026. It added [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] as a step in making [[Steel Alloy|steel]], moved [[Electrum Alloy|electrum]] to the end of progression, and improved [[Trial Chambers|trial chamber]] loot.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.03}}</ref>

The notes explain that the developer enjoyed watching players experiment and would deliberately leave some features without advancements, such as [[jewelry]], special books, villages and fetishes, while making steel and smithing "as intuitive as possible".

== Additions ==
* [[Carbon-Rich Iron|Carbon-rich iron]] and its advancement ("A Brittle Alloy?").
* The "Hidden Flavors" (secret ingredient) and "Wait, you can make that?" (secret meal) advancements.
* [[Warding Stone|Warding stones]] cannot be placed in [[Trial Chambers|trial chambers]].
* Clay can be cooked on a [[Kindling|kindling]].
* [[Mud Kiln|Kiln]] recipes for charcoal and all glazed terracotta.

== Changes ==
=== Steel and electrum ===
* Steel now has an intermediate item, carbon-rich iron. The developer had originally represented the cost of carbon with a long cooking time, but found waiting unfun, so the carbon cost moved into a recipe that uses a coal block, which can also be made from charcoal.
* Electrum is crafted with [[Divine Fragment|divine fragments]], like [[Adamant Alloy|adamant]], to mark it as endgame, and has the enchantment glint.

=== Other ===
* Blaze drops reduced slightly.
* [[Freezing water]] no longer causes Blindness, and its Darkness and Slowness last less time.
* The [[Silver Sword|silver sword]], [[Warding Sword|warding sword]] and [[Warding Shield|warding shield]] were nerfed.
* The [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] texture was changed to make smithing clearer.
* Sapling recipes unlock when the player gets the logs, not the leaves, because players who never picked up leaves could not find them.
* Fortune no longer affects spawners. The developer found four fragments per spawner "just too much", especially with elytra and [[Nether Fortress|nether fortresses]] making spawners easy to reach.
* Removed one splash text that the developer thought some people might find hurtful, and added others.
* Steel and iron [[Dolabra|dolabras]] have their intended attack speed.
* The [[anvil]] can no longer be crafted from iron blocks.

== Fixes ==
* The overworld's darkness was stark and very dark. This was fixed, although the developer asked players which they preferred. "True darkness" returned in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]].
* The vanilla chest recipe had been unblocked, creating a duplicate. There are now two chest recipes, from logs and from planks, in the same group.
* Sticks from logs unlock properly.
* Short dry grass can be crafted from tall dry grass.
* Wool can be crafted back from carpet.
* Yellow beds and carpets can no longer be made from hay bales.
* Fixed the name of golden steamed carrots.
* Added the anvil smithing error sprite.
* Blocked the vanilla netherite recipes.
* Looting made [[Wither Skeleton|wither skeletons]] drop their heads less often. This was fixed.
* Iron lanterns and chains unlock on obtaining ingots, and soul lanterns, [[Soul Kindling|soul kindling]] and soul torches unlock on obtaining soul fire base blocks.
* Divine fragments appear in trial chambers.
* Increased the chance of maces from trial chambers.
* Apples heal as much as their tooltip says.
* Bruschetta works.
